faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The posts are on a contractual basis for an initial period of one year, comprising 11 serving months plus a 01 month break period, which is extendable to three years subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirements.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Govt rules.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process on a date to be intimated later.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline by submitting their applications either by hand or through India Post to the Principal, Sainik School Rewari.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The application must reach within 21 days after the publication of the advertisement under advertisement number EN 29/1.
